name: v11_deferred_revenue_quality_reversal
hypothesis: Higher deferred revenue relative to sales can proxy customer prepayments and revenue visibility. Add gross margin and a small intraday reversal stabilizer.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank((fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt) / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Different from receivables: uses customer prepayment/revenue visibility plus gross margin.

name: v11_deferred_revenue_growth_sales_growth
hypothesis: Growth in deferred revenue backed by sales growth can indicate improving demand visibility rather than accounting noise.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests growth/visibility rather than the level of deferred revenue.

name: v11_cash_earnings_quality
hypothesis: Cash flow from operations exceeding accounting operating income can indicate higher earnings quality and lower accrual risk.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(cash_flow_from_operations / assets - operating_income / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * receivable / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Uses CFO minus operating-income quality; receivables/reversal are only small stabilizers.

name: v11_gross_margin_sales_growth
hypothesis: Gross-margin strength combined with sales growth can identify quality growth distinct from pure ROE or EPS yield.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Tests operating margin/growth quality with a light reversal component.

name: v11_payables_increase_cashflow_quality
hypothesis: Accounts payable and accrued liabilities increase can improve working-capital cash conversion when supported by operating cash flow.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_apalch / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(cash_flow_from_operations / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests payables/accrual-liability working-capital financing, not receivables.

name: v11_capex_discipline_cashflow
hypothesis: Lower capital expenditure intensity combined with strong operating cash flow can proxy disciplined investment and free-cash-flow quality.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capital_expenditure_amount / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(cash_flow_from_operations / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Follow-up to weak asset-growth branch, using capex intensity and CFO rather than total asset growth.
